source_anchors.context: NQuery Advisor software (GraphPad Software DBA Statistical Solutions, San Diego, CA, USA) was applied for estimating the sample size. Based on a one-group, two-sided t-test with a medium effect size according to Cohen’s d = 0.50 [29], α = 5% and a power of 80% a sample size of n = 34 participants for final data analysis was calculated. Considering an estimated fail-out rate of 50% between screening and final inclusion, we aimed to include 68 subjects in the medical screening.

Overall, n = 39 (females: 27; males: 12) participants (age = 55.2 ± 10.3 years; BMI = 31.1 ± 3.0 kg/m2) were included in the study. All participants were German citizens. Baseline characteristics and frequencies of the prevalence (risk for) each of the included diseases are outlined in Table 2. N = 12 (31%) participants showed one manifested disease which was accompanied by at least one risk factor. Two simultaneous manifested diseases were reported by n = 18 (46%) participants, three diseases by n = 7 (18%) and n = 1 (3%) participant showed four manifested diseases.

anchor.context: Adherence. Mean adherence to the prescribed training sessions of the first 12-weeks (n = 38) was 79 ± 9% for endurance exercise sessions 74 ± 14% for strengthening exercise sessions.
